mapper.select: SELECT ob.outbound_id AS "outboundId", ob.outbound_no AS "outboundNo", ob.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "salesOrderNo", ob.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.warehouse_name AS "warehouseName", ob.status AS "status", ob.cancel_reason AS "cancelReason", ob.cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt" FROM outbound ob JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = ob.sales_order_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ob.warehouse_id WHERE ob.company_id = #{companyId} AND ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId}
SELECT warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", warehouse_name AS "warehouseName" FROM warehouse WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY warehouse_name, warehouse_id

SELECT l.lot_id AS "lotId", l.lot_no AS "lotNo", ls.quantity AS "quantity" FROM lot_stock ls JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ls.lot_id WHERE ls.company_id = #{companyId} AND ls.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.product_id = #{productId} AND ls.quantity > 0 ORDER BY l.lot_id

SELECT oi.outbound_item_id AS "outboundItemId", ob.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", oi.sales_order_item_id AS "salesOrderItemId", ob.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", soi.product_id AS "productId", p.lot_managed_yn AS "lotManagedYn", oi.base_shipped_qty AS "baseShippedQty", soi.base_ordered_qty AS "baseOrderedQty", soi.shipped_qty AS "shippedQty", soi.version AS "version" FROM outbound ob JOIN outbound_item oi ON oi.outbound_id = ob.outbound_id JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.sales_order_item_id = oi.sales_order_item_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = soi.product_id AND p.company_id = ob.company_id WHERE ob.company_id = #{companyId} AND ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY oi.line_no

SELECT oi.outbound_item_id AS "outboundItemId", oil.lot_id AS "lotId", oil.base_lot_qty AS "baseLotQty" FROM outbound ob JOIN outbound_item oi ON oi.outbound_id = ob.outbound_id JOIN outbound_item_lot oil ON oil.outbound_item_id = oi.outbound_item_id WHERE ob.company_id = #{companyId} AND ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY oi.line_no, oil.outbound_item_lot_id
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{confirmedBy} WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE outbound SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, cancelled_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{cancelledBy} WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'

UPDATE sales_order so SET shipment_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id AND soi.shipped_qty < soi.base_ordered_qty ) THEN 'SHIPPED'
WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id AND soi.shipped_qty > 0 ) THEN 'PARTIAL'
ELSE 'NOT_SHIPPED' END,
updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND so.company_id = #{companyId} AND so.order_status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT so.company_id AS "companyId", so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", soi.product_id AS "productId", p.lot_managed_yn AS "lotManagedYn", soi.base_ordered_qty AS "baseOrderedQty", soi.shipped_qty AS "shippedQty", pu.conversion_qty AS "conversionQty" FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = soi.sales_order_id JOIN product_unit pu ON pu.product_unit_id = #{productUnitId} AND pu.product_id = soi.product_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = soi.product_id WHERE soi.sales_order_item_id = #{salesOrderItemId} AND pu.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound ( company_id, outbound_no, sales_order_id, warehouse_id, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{outboundNo}, #{salesOrderId}, #{warehouseId}, 'DRAFT', #{createdBy} )

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbound_item_lot oil WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbound_item oi JOIN outbound ob ON ob.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id WHERE oi.outbound_item_id = oil.outbound_item_id AND ob.company_id = #{companyId} AND ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId} AND ob.status = 'DRAFT' )
mapper.select: SELECT ob.outbound_id AS "outboundId", ob.outbound_no AS "outboundNo", ob.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "salesOrderNo", ob.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.warehouse_name AS "warehouseName", ob.status AS "status", ob.cancel_reason AS "cancelReason", ob.cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt" FROM outbound ob JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = ob.sales_order_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ob.warehouse_id WHERE ob.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY ob.outbound_id DESC

SELECT oi.outbound_item_id AS "outboundItemId", oil.lot_id AS "lotId", oil.base_lot_qty AS "baseLotQty" FROM outbound_item oi JOIN outbound_item_lot oil ON oil.outbound_item_id = oi.outbound_item_id JOIN outbound ob ON ob.outbound_id = oi.outbound_id WHERE ob.company_id = #{companyId} AND ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY oi.line_no, oil.outbound_item_lot_id
